billing_analytics_outbox_event_check.name: billing_analytics_outbox_event_check
billing_analytics_outbox_event_check.value: ("billing_analytics_outbox"."kind" = 'event' AND "billing_analytics_outbox"."event_name" IS NOT NULL) OR ("billing_analytics_outbox"."kind" = 'traits' AND "billing_analytics_outbox"."event_name" IS NULL)

billing_checkout_attempt_session_check.name: billing_checkout_attempt_session_check
billing_checkout_attempt_session_check.value: ("billing_checkout_attempt"."status" = 'creating' AND "billing_checkout_attempt"."stripe_checkout_session_id" IS NULL AND "billing_checkout_attempt"."stripe_checkout_url" IS NULL AND "billing_checkout_attempt"."expires_at" IS NULL) OR ("billing_checkout_attempt"."status" <> 'creating' AND "billing_checkout_attempt"."stripe_checkout_session_id" IS NOT NULL)

billing_subscription_pending_seat_check.name: billing_subscription_pending_seat_check
billing_subscription_pending_seat_check.value: ("billing_subscription"."pending_seat_quantity" IS NULL AND "billing_subscription"."pending_seat_expires_at" IS NULL) OR ("billing_subscription"."pending_seat_quantity" > 0 AND "billing_subscription"."pending_seat_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)

ingest_job_lease_check.name: ingest_job_lease_check
ingest_job_lease_check.value:
(
				"ingest_job"."status" = 'running'
				AND "ingest_job"."lease_token" IS NOT NULL
				AND length(btrim("ingest_job"."lease_token")) > 0
				AND "ingest_job"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL
			) OR (
				"ingest_job"."status" <> 'running'
				AND "ingest_job"."lease_token" IS NULL
				AND "ingest_job"."lease_expires_at" IS NULL
			)

ingest_job_terminal_state_check.name: ingest_job_terminal_state_check
ingest_job_terminal_state_check.value:
(
				"ingest_job"."status" = 'completed'
				AND "ingest_job"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL
				AND "ingest_job"."failed_at" IS NULL
				AND "ingest_job"."content_sha256" IS NOT NULL
				AND "ingest_job"."result" IS NOT NULL
			) OR (
				"ingest_job"."status" = 'failed'
				AND "ingest_job"."completed_at" IS NULL
				AND "ingest_job"."failed_at" IS NOT NULL
				AND "ingest_job"."last_error_code" IS NOT NULL
			) OR (
				"ingest_job"."status" IN ('pending', 'running')
				AND "ingest_job"."completed_at" IS NULL
				AND "ingest_job"."failed_at" IS NULL
			)

ingest_processing_ledger_terminal_check.name: ingest_processing_ledger_terminal_check
ingest_processing_ledger_terminal_check.value:
(
				"ingest_processing_ledger"."status" = 'completed'
				AND "ingest_processing_ledger"."result" IS NOT NULL
				AND "ingest_processing_ledger"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL
			) OR (
				"ingest_processing_ledger"."status" = 'processing'
				AND "ingest_processing_ledger"."completed_at" IS NULL
			)

ingest_rate_limit_counter_subject_check.name: ingest_rate_limit_counter_subject_check
ingest_rate_limit_counter_subject_check.value:
(
				"ingest_rate_limit_counter"."api_key_id" IS NOT NULL
				AND "ingest_rate_limit_counter"."user_id" IS NULL
			) OR (
				"ingest_rate_limit_counter"."api_key_id" IS NULL
				AND "ingest_rate_limit_counter"."user_id" IS NOT NULL
			)
